title: Recipe 07: Search, filters, and long lists
titleZh: 方案07：搜索、筛选与长列表
summary: A bounded ticket view separates total, matched, and rendered counts, with search, status filtering, records, and paged rendering.
summaryZh: 有界工单视图区分总数、匹配数与已渲染数，包含搜索、状态筛选、记录与分页渲染。

files.label: App.vue
files.role: Long list, filters, state, and row actions
files.roleZh: 长列表、筛选、状态与行内动作

guide.title: Keep the list bounded and the counts honest
guide.titleZh: 保持列表有界，计数诚实
intro: The fixture has 160 tickets, but only a small rendered window enters the DOM.
Ask for a search or show-more operation and compare total, matched, and rendered counts.
introZh: 夹具共有 160 张工单，但只有一小段渲染窗口进入 DOM。
执行搜索或显示更多，并比较总数、匹配数与已渲染数。

steps.title: Report the current view
steps.body: The state view carries applied filters and counts, while records carry row fields.
steps.bodyZh: 状态视图携带已应用筛选与计数，记录携带行字段。

steps.title: Declare stable row fields
steps.body: Each row has an id and only the business fields needed to choose an action.
steps.bodyZh: 每行有 id 与选择动作所需的业务字段。

steps.title: Render more explicitly
steps.body: A separate tool grows the rendered window; it does not silently ship the whole table.
steps.bodyZh: 独立工具扩大渲染窗口，而不是悄悄发送整张表。

guide.note: Search for Globex or switch to urgent rows, then use Show 30 more. The matched count can exceed the rendered count.
guide.noteZh: 搜索 Globex 或切换紧急工单，再点“再显示 30 条”。匹配数可以大于已渲染数。
